explanation: This route is vulnerable to SQL injection (CWE-89) because session['username'] is concatenated directly into the MySQL query inside cursor.execute(). If a username containing SQL metacharacters is stored in the session, requesting /summary could alter the query to access unauthorized records. The repair attempts parameterization with %s, but omits the trailing comma in (session['username']), passing a bare string instead of a 1-tuple and causing a parameter-binding bug.
